encoding: Lossless repeated-subtree interning; $ref names pool entries. Every original metric and command is retained.

value.scope:
Actual SH4 selection/replay setup plus a bounded 16-byte metadata probe.

The complete native_static.cpp translation unit is compiled with Make-derived
flags. Only emit_pick's geometry body is an observed boundary: transform,
clipping, TA and cache-miss latency are excluded. The separate metadata probe
consumes every logical emit field using the production reader, then writes four
test-only observation words. Its cycles are probe cycles, not renderer time.
Combined metadata lines are the union of actual selector reads and that full
16-byte consumption; they are neither cache fills nor a 43% world-byte saving.
The established Build 5 test-only return stubs/linker layout are reused. No
runtime SH4 assembly or linker change is introduced.

controls: data read of current opcode word retained
double-register move counted as one 8-byte load
store queues excluded from cached footprint
cached PREF counted separately from demand loads

division_init_controls.scope: All M/Q/T inputs, other state preserved, one retired instruction, no data traffic; DIV1 not implemented.

value.whole_frame: See report for explicitly MODELLED setup-only scenario; no geometry, D-cache stalls, console or r101 prediction.

pool.r0000:
Price actual dynamic instruction traces with the repository's hwsim model.

Perfect caches, no memory/bus/SQ/DMA events and no final completion drain.
This is a synthetic CPU scheduling comparison, never hardware time or FPS.
pool.r0004:
Observe real opcode data accesses without inventing cache misses.

Instruction fetches are excluded; PC-relative literal loads are data loads.
The fixture maps cached RAM at low synthetic addresses, which become the
0x8c000000 alias only for the pipeline-model ELF. Distinct 32-byte lines are
working-set/touch counts, not measured fills or hardware bus transactions.

r0005.scope: PREF requests observed separately; not demand loads, fills or guaranteed useful transfers

pool.r0016: Architectural demand accesses; ordinary emit region includes its interleaved bounds. Region line counts can overlap; use metadata_union/all for unions.
